text_block_list.text:
One day, as I pass by the station on my
way
home...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I want to buy a ticket, but there
are so
many people that I can't get to
the ticket
machines.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I don't know what to do...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Fight my way through, huh? Okay. That's

something I'm good at.

Oguri Cap heads to the ticket machine,
muscling
her way through the crowd like
a snowplow at the
height of winter.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I managed to get a ticket. That
was harder
than I thought it'd be.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea making a purchase at a
ticket
machine would be such a stressful
experience...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, thanks. Your advice was really
helpful.
I'm gonna get going now.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Wait for the right moment, huh? Okay,
I'll see
what I can do.

Oguri Cap slowly makes her way through
the
crowd and pops out right in front of
the ticket
machine.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the advice. I managed to nab
myself a
ticket.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it looks like my train's almost here.
I'd better
get going now. Bye.

Matching the pace of those around you,
then
bursting through at the final
moment... That might
make for a good
race strategy on slower tracks.
